Strings: GET / SET / MGET against Redis string keys. The simplest key-value layer — read and write opaque values.
Hashes: HGET / HSET / HGETALL / HSCAN — for field-keyed records stored under one Redis key. The `_over_scan` variant pairs SCAN with HSCAN for high-throughput bulk reads.
Lists: LPUSH / LRANGE — interact with Redis lists. Use `redis_lrange_list` (VARCHAR[]) or `redis_lrange_table` (one row per element) rather than parsing the comma-separated form.
Keys: DEL / EXISTS / TYPE / SCAN — keyspace introspection and management. Key listing is built on cursor-paginated SCAN, never the server-blocking KEYS command.
Expiry: EXPIRE / EXPIREAT / TTL — set and inspect key time-to-live.
Commands: `redis_command` runs any Redis command given as a VARCHAR[] — for sets, sorted sets, counters and everything else without a dedicated function.
